# Remote Control Agent v0.1.50 — macOS remote unattended upgrade

This pinned five-platform Agent Release adds the explicitly owner-authorized **one-shot macOS detached upgrade** source path to the previously released Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64, and macOS 15+ ARM64/Intel x64 packages. It is a release of the existing Agent, not a new service, updater, MCP tool, pairing protocol, or Worker.

## Changes

- macOS: the reviewed native installation archive includes a bounded same-user `launchctl submit` one-shot upgrade worker that runs independently from the initiating Remote Control Shell, using the current SHA-pinned public installer and the existing transaction, freeze, activation and rollback logic.
- macOS: preserve approved permanent owner identity, STOP state, durable SQLite operation receipts and the previous version; reject wrong architecture, non-forward version, unexpected endpoint/owner, unknown launchd job, outstanding work and uncertain upgrade state. Return launch acknowledgement separately from independently verified signed WSS completion.
- Linux CI/Session identity: resolve the transient two-link race during atomic GitHub Runner Session identity publication. Keep the final private, owner-owned and single-hardlink acceptance invariant, including rejection of persistent aliases.
- Retain prior Linux/Windows one-click installers, detached owner tasks, macOS interactive install/upgrade and existing release/rollback architecture.

## Release and validation boundary

- Source: `1195b8c9fb7d511bd685e32bf3fc00039be0d815` ([macOS PR #111](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/111), [Session identity PR #112](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/112), [versioned-candidate test PR #113](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/113)). Final merged-main native CI [#41452399877](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41452399877) and pinned five-platform candidate CI [#41452847521](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41452847521), attempt 2: Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64, macOS ARM64/x64 all passed. Native macOS ARM64 was retried once after a Runner queue timeout; no candidate code or safety gate was bypassed.
- This Agent release alone does **not** update the deployed Worker installer Pin, enable public `--remote-upgrade` or upgrade any paired Mac. Separate owner authorization is required for Worker production rollout and original-Mac Remote Control-only upgrade/independent signed WSS, stable ID and receipt verification.
- Already waived physical-host scenarios (Intel owner hardware, login/logout, sleep/wake, failure injection) remain Waived, not Pass. Neither hosted native CI nor archive digest checks certify Apple Developer ID signing, notarization, TCC or Gatekeeper approval. Do not bypass OS protection, re-pair or delete historical receipts.

Related: [Spec #657](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/657), [Ticket #660](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/660).
